name: manim-plugin
description: Author math-heavy Manim animations: a math-first scene API, a local engine that renders, checks and diagnoses scenes, and a live workbench.

interface.shortDescription: Author and render math-heavy Manim animations
interface.longDescription: Write Manim scenes with a math-first API (stepwise derivations, theme-aware symbol colors, beats), then render, grab stills and contact sheets, run visual QA, check derivations numerically and diagnose failures with file:line findings through a local engine. Large logs and media stay out of the conversation; the live workbench shows scenes, renders and findings side by side.
defaultPrompt: Animate a derivation of the quadratic formula
Render this scene and show me a contact sheet
Find out why my Manim scene fails to render
